hooks.command: bash -c 'cmd=$(jq -r ".tool_input.command // empty"); if [[ -z "$cmd" ]]; then exit 0; fi; if [[ -n "$MIZAN_ALLOW_PRODUCTION" ]]; then exit 0; fi; if echo "$cmd" | grep -Eq "(^|[^a-zA-Z0-9_-])(git[[:space:]]+push|gh[[:space:]]+pr[[:space:]]+merge|fly[[:space:]]+deploy|stripe[[:space:]]+(live|--live))(\b|$)"; then echo "[mizan-ai-native] BLOCKED: production action attempted before MVP validation gate passed." >&2; echo "See MIZAN_AI_NATIVE_PLAN.md \"Release sequencing lock\" / Post-MVP track." >&2; echo "Override with MIZAN_ALLOW_PRODUCTION=1 only when Sami has explicitly OK\u2019d the action." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'file_path=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty" 2>/dev/null); if [[ -n "$file_path" && -f "$file_path" ]]; then if [[ "$file_path" == *.rs ]]; then rustfmt --edition 2021 "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true; elif [[ "$file_path" =~ \.(ts|tsx|js|jsx|css|md|json|yml|yaml)$ ]]; then npx --yes --quiet prettier --write "$file_path" 2>/dev/null || true; fi; fi'
